reviews.text: 10 STARS! Thank you so much for looking after Ceasur. He was so well looked after for the 10days we were away for he was  loved, walked and spoiled! It was so lovely getting updates and video while I was away.[I can't show you the vids as it dont upload them  take it from me brillant  vids] I came home to a very happy boy. Such peace of mind knowing he was in safe, caring hands. Best dog sitter around I highly recommend them will be using there service again

If ever you feel anxious about leaving your dog with someone whilst your away in holiday or even a weekend break you definitely dont need to with this company, daily updates pictures and videos puts you at ease the whole time, I highly recommend this company and will definitely use them again, brilliant service!

I won’t put my dogs anywhere else when we go away. Raheel‘s communication and customer service the second and none and he cares about the dogs like they’re his own giving them love attention and exercise

Very impressed with GrizzlysWalks. The staff is attentive and patient, especially with energetic dogs like mine. I’ve seen a noticeable change in my dog’s behaviour less destructive at home and more calm after daycare sessions.

I was honestly a bit worried before trying GrizzlysWalks but they completely changed my mind. The place feels safe, organised and very clean. My puppy settled in faster than expected and now gets excited every morning. I can clearly see he is well cared for, active and mentally stimulated throughout the day.

GrizzlysWalks has been an amazing support for my daily routine. My dog used to struggle staying alone at home but now he looks forward to every visit. The staff are calm, professional, and genuinely caring. I’ve noticed improved behaviour, better social skills and a much happier attitude when he returns home.
A First time stay with Grizzly walks, Rahlle insurerd our dogs needs were met with a daily update - would recommend as you can ensure your pet is in safe experienced hands! ***** 5Star.

Top lads took care of my little chihuahua called Dadyal Kashmiri, he learned manners and doesnt poop and urinate all over the place now

Thanks so much for rehabilitating Dadyal Kashmiri!

Grizzlyswalks boarded my 9 year old Jack Russell and he had 5 star treatment lots of walks and extra on lead training. He had lots of play time with ball play which he loves. Drop off and pick up was not rushed at all spent my time dropping him off untill I was ready to say goodbye (which I needed more than my dog did) will definitely bring my dog back he was cared for so well .

Raheel looked after our boisterous young chocolate lab Sidney beautifully. He took him walking regularly, did some training and got him to socialise with other dogs. I would definitely book Sidney in to be looked after again by Raheel-he had a great time! Thank you Raheel!

Great experience, easily onboarded and my dog was well looked after over a few days.

Would recommend for people with large dog breeds.

I sent my 10 month Doberman to GrizzlyWalks for a week while I was away on holiday and he came back happier than even. I was nervous about leaving him at first however Raheel ensured he would be well looked after and gave me daily updates of how he’s been. Highly recommend and I for sure will be using them again.

I recently left my dog in the care of GrizzlysWalks for approx two and a half weeks while I travelled abroad, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. Throughout my time away, I was sent regular photos and video updates showing my dog enjoying walks and playtime, which was incredibly reassuring.
It was clear from the updates and communication that my Cane Corso was being well looked after by someone who genuinely cares about the animals in their care. I found Raheel the person looking after my dog to be trustworthy, attentive, and kind.
When I returned and went to pick up my boy, he looked healthy, happy, and clearly well-cared for. I wouldn't hesitate to use GrizzlyWalks again and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a safe and loving place for their pet.

Great set up to care for the dogs by a team whom don’t just love dogs but know how to handle them. I don’t just want my dog to be looked after and cared for I want him to retain the training that I have meticulously instilled in him from being 10weeks old and I get all of the above with GrizzlysWalks as-well as consistent updates, videos and photos I couldn’t ask for more! Thank you, Miles and I will see you soon

Grizzlys walks has been a lifesaver for us and our roomie rescue Dixie who's very reactive to strangers. We was struggling to find anyone that could help but Raheel has been amazing with both her and me! Sending me regular videos of how she was doing and he taking the time to build a bond with her. He was even able to fuss her after the first visit, which I've never been able to do the first time she meets a new person. Highly recommended!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I left my German Shepherd with GrizzlysWalks for a week, and I couldn’t be happier with the care he received. He is aggressive, but they handled him with confidence and professionalism, making me feel completely at ease. They kept me updated throughout his stay, regularly sending pictures and letting me know how he was doing, which was really reassuring.
It’s not easy finding a place that truly understands dogs with behavioral challenges, but GrizzlysWalks went above and beyond expectations. They took such great care of him, and I’m so grateful for their patience and dedication. Thank you so much. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and skilled team!

We are extremely happy with the service! Our dog stayed for seven days, and throughout his stay, we received regular updates on how he was doing. He is reactive to people, but the team made him feel comfortable, and he quickly warmed up to them. It was clear he was happy and well cared for the entire time. Thank you—we will definitely be returning!
Great experience, my dog really enjoyed and was in safe hands, fast responses when i asked how my dog was doing
Great experience! The facility was clean, and the staff was incredibly friendly. My dog seemed to love it here.
I’ve tried other places, but nothing compares to GrizzlysWalks. The team is fantastic, and the care is top-notch.

GrizzlysWalks is a dream come true for dog parents. The staff is so knowledgeable and friendly, and you can tell they genuinely care about the dogs. My dog is usually a little shy, but he warmed up to them right away and had such a fun time. The daily updates with photos were a bonus!
Affordable and amazing care! I’m so impressed with the attention my dog received at GrizzlysWalks.

This was the first time I boarded my dog, and I was nervous, but GrizzlysWalks made it such a positive experience. They were incredibly professional and kind, answering all my questions before the stay. When I picked up my dog, he looked so happy and calm—it was clear he was well-loved during his time there.

I’m so grateful for Grizzly’s, we’ve started training with Adam and Raheel boarded my reactive German shepherd for a few days. Given her behaviour we’ve been turned away from other kennels and day care but Raheel took the time to interact with Lola to gain her trust and make sure she got the attention she needed at a pace she needed. Reassuring contact and updates  the whole time also made this a great experience!

After being rejected by two other facilities. I was so relieved to find this place. My high energy husky was welcomed with open arms, and he gets the exercise and attention he needs. Thank you for giving him a chance.

My Labrador needed an outlet for all his energy, and this daycare has been a lifesaver. He gets plenty of exercise and comes home well- behaved after a day of playing and learning with other dogs. I’ve noted a huge improvement in his obedience too.

My dog has improved so much since we started brining him here. The combination of exercise, socialisation and consistent reinforcement of his training has made him calmer and more obedient. I am very impressed.
This daycare goes above and beyond by combining playtime and structured learning. Lots of play time and highly recommend.
Our rescue dog was turned away from other daycares due to his nervousness, but here, they took the time to make him feel comfortable. He’s now confident and excited to go every day. Thank you a lot
Thank you!

Finding a daycare for my giant new foundland was a challenge - most places couldn’t accommodate him. This play is different! They embraced him and he’s made a few friends. Excellent for socialisation if you have a big dog.

absolutely fantastic service! Looked after my 14 week old Shepherd whilst I was away for four days, Kept in touch with me throughout And also socialised him, which was fantastic! Will definitely be using your services again!

Chase had an amazing time with Raheel after having to go to day care following a last minute booking. I would highly recommend grizzlys to anyone looking for a dog sitter in the area! Chase is very happy and has obviously had a nice time! Thank you both 😊 …

Cassie has just spent 10 days at GrizzlysWalks while we were away, finding somewhere for her to board was very last minute, she could not have been in better hands, she can be defensive, as she is a rescue dog who did not have a great start, she did not take to Raheel at the start but within minutes his brother performed a miracle and they became best friends. The videos and message's from Raheel every day were a god send. We cannot recommend them enough, we are so grateful to them.

I recently used GrizzlysWalks and couldn't be happier with their service. The team is professional, clearly passionate about dogs, and took a personalised approach to my dog’s care. The atmosphere is fantastic, making my Rottweiler feel safe and happy. Communication has been excellent, with regular updates and photos. I highly recommend GrizzlysWalks for their dedication and exceptional care.

Amazing business helped us at the last minute when all other day cares rejected our GSD with Seperation Anxiety, we got photos and pictures throughout the day and our dog didnt want to leave! Would definately recommend and use again!
Was very friendly and took our dog very easily and professionally. Our dog came out very happy. 😊 …

Amazing place to drop your dogs when you’re gone for the weekend. From the daily updates to the pictures of what my Rottweiler gets up to during the day - just a great service would recommend to everyone
Left my Rottweiler with Raheel for the day and the service was excellent will definitely be booking more regular sessions for Zeus definitely
Looked after my dog with care thank you very much, will definitely be coming back again next week
